Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independently painted 2D game character portrait plus separate specialty object, one Zaun commander for original 1999 Heroes of Might and Magic III. This must be a finished painted bitmap master, not a 3D render.

Rendering language: match supplied ORIGINAL HoMM3 portrait reference's compact realistic face, sculpted painted facial planes, directional upper-left warm light, strong value separation, slightly rough oil-painted metal/leather/cloth, restrained highlights; readable at58x64 and48x32. The original reference is style only; do not reproduce any of its faces. Official LoR image supplies character anatomy/clothing cues only; do NOT copy its scene or pose. Independently paint the new close portrait. Subject and separate object: KAY, the named Practical Perfectionist, an ingenious young woman of Zaun's workshop streets. Warm light brown skin, natural hazel eyes, black-brown hair swept across forehead and tied into two unruly low ponytails, small crossed ivory fabric sticking-plaster on cheek, bright practical attentive half-smile. Sleeveless teal work blouse, dark brown fingerless mechanic glove and worn forearm brace visible low in composition. A workshop pipe and dim green glass condenser behind her, not large weapons. Specialty object: a compact open brass-cased mechanical calculator with several exposed gears and a small closed leather-bound notebook beside it; represents native Intelligence skill, no copies or timeline ghosts.
